variables.title: Variables
variables.notes: Ada uses explicit typing with a `Name : Type := Value;` syntax. Constants are marked with the `constant` keyword.

data_types.title: Data Types
data_types.notes: Ada has extremely strong typing. Developers frequently create constrained subtypes or entirely new types to prevent invalid states.

operators.title: Operators
operators.notes: Ada uses `=` for equality and `/=` for inequality. Exponentiation is built-in with `**`.

conditionals.title: Conditionals
conditionals.notes: Conditionals use explicit `then` and require an `end if;` terminator, making blocks unambiguous.

for_loop.title: For Loop
for_loop.notes: For loops iterate over a discrete range. The loop variable is implicitly declared and read-only within the loop.

while_loop.title: While Loop
while_loop.notes: While loops use explicit `loop` and `end loop;` markers. There is no `++` operator in Ada.

functions.title: Functions
functions.notes: Ada distinguishes between `function` (which returns a value) and `procedure` (which does not).

arrays.title: Arrays
arrays.notes: Arrays in Ada can have any discrete type as their index (including enums), and they are strictly bounds-checked.

maps.title: Maps
maps.notes: Maps are provided via the generic `Ada.Containers` library, which requires explicit instantiation for specific types.

error_handling.title: Error Handling
error_handling.notes: Exceptions are built-in. Code blocks can have an `exception` section at the end to catch specifically named errors.

comments.title: Comments & Documentation
comments.notes: Ada provides comments to document code behavior.

numbers.title: Numbers & Constants
numbers.notes: Ada supports numeric literals for computation and indexing.

booleans.title: Booleans & Conditions
booleans.notes: Ada provides boolean conditions for program control flow.

type_casting.title: Type Conversion
type_casting.notes: Ada converts data between native format representations.

strings.title: Strings & Characters
strings.notes: Ada represents textual data through string literals and character arrays.

string_formatting.title: String Formatting
string_formatting.notes: Ada formats and joins textual values for display and output.

pattern_matching.title: Conditionals & Branching
pattern_matching.code:
case value of
    1: execute_one()
    default: execute_default()
pattern_matching.notes: Ada branches execution based on value comparison and conditional expressions.

range.title: Ranges & Intervals
range.notes: Ada defines intervals and index sequences for bounded processing.

iterators.title: Iteration & Loops
iterators.notes: Ada iterates across collections and sequence elements.

oop_classes.title: Structures & Modules
oop_classes.notes: Ada organizes data and behavior through structures or modular components.

lists.title: Collections & Arrays
lists.notes: Ada stores sequence data in indexed lists or arrays.

tuples.title: Records & Pairs
tuples.notes: Ada groups related fields into lightweight composite pairs or records.

sets.title: Sets & Uniqueness
sets.notes: Ada tracks unique values without duplicate entries.

modules_import.title: Libraries & Modules
modules_import.notes: Ada organizes external libraries and code units into modular namespaces.
